Ava (CSE): quick check-in — flagged an unusual hosted spend bump for Orchid in the last 24h. Usage ~180% of their commit, but latency and error rate are steady. Seen any product changes or marketing pushes? cc @Marco (CSM) @Priya (Billing) :eyes:
Marco (CSM): hmm that's big. Orchid onboarding is ongoing but I haven't heard about a campaign. I'll ping their PM. Do we have the raw delta numbers?
Priya (Billing): ran the flag — spend went from $8.2k/day to $23.4k/day around 03:14 UTC yesterday. Commit is $10k/day. Alert id: billing-flag-2025-11-05-03. Bot shows 127% over commit when averaged, but peak was 234%.
Jon-bot: billing-alert: ORCHID exceeded commit threshold
```
client: orchid
window: 24h
commit_daily: 10000
observed_peak: 23400
alert_id: billing-flag-2025-11-05-0314
```
Lena (EngOps): quick triage checklist: 1) any large embedding/export jobs? 2) new model variant deployed? 3) cache busting on prefix keys? I can check KV cache hit rate and batching config if you want.
Ava (CSE): good list — Marco can you ask if they ran a data migration or export? Priya, can we see token breakdown (chat vs embeddings) and per-route costs?
Priya (Billing): on it — pulling per-route now. Preliminary: 78% of extra spend is embeddings route /v1/embeddings. Rest is standard chat. Possible batch-run.
Marco (CSM): PM says they launched a “user migration” script yesterday that calls embeddings in bulk. They expected a one-time burst but didn't realize it would run across all tenants at once.
Ava (CSE): ok that's likely root cause. Two follow-ups: 1) Offer a one-time commit buffer or credit for the unexpected burst? 2) Work with Eng to recommend rate-limits or batching config to avoid future spikes. Thoughts? :thought_balloon:
Priya (Billing): propose: grant a one-off absorption up to $5k and provide detailed usage report + tips. Need sign-off from finance for >$5k.
Lena (EngOps): I can draft a short doc on safe bulk-embedding patterns (concurrency, batch size, KV prefixing). Also can throttle routing via per-customer policy until they apply it.
Marco (CSM): I'll coordinate the customer call and include the migration schedule. Ava — can you join?
Ava (CSE): yes, I can join. Proposed next steps: 1) Marco schedules call today, 2) Priya sends usage + proposed one-off absorption, 3) Lena publishes recommendations and sets temporary throttle, 4) Jon-bot will keep the flag open until next check.
Jon-bot: ticket created: CS-ORCHID-1756 — monitoring enabled, will ping channel on next 6h interval.
Ava (CSE): thanks all. Keeping this thread for updates — will close when spend normalizes. :thumbsup:
